authorization: User selected Decision Point A to proceed with exploratory three-fold baseline training on the expanded 17-molecule cohort (including Piscidin 1 and BMAP-27B).
scope: local small-sample E. coli MIC exploration on 17 molecules; no dual-task, clinical, external-validation, deployment or publication authorization

validation.partition: use the frozen whole-component roles; no new split or seed search

features.name: existing fixed handcrafted sequence descriptors
features.selection: no feature selection or outcome-informed redesign

logistic_regression.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only inside each training complement

model_design_rationale: Reuse existing fixed LR/RF baseline parameters and add a prior-only control. No model performance has been produced for this expanded cohort. Do not use internal random calibration CV on these few independent groups.
output: fold models, features, per-molecule out-of-fold predictions, fold and pooled descriptive metrics, immutable manifest
model_selection: none; report all predeclared models; no best-model selection or full-cohort deployment fit
limitations: Expanded cohort contains 17 molecules, 6 positives and 11 negatives across 8 indivisible components; each validation fold contains strictly 2 positives.
Piscidin 1 facility synthesis resin at UTSW unreported; Todd Hewitt broth non-standard; condition limitations remain explicit.
BMAP-27B multiresistant CREC isolate context and heatmap resolution bracket (1.563-6.250 ug/mL) noted as limitations.
Strains and assay conditions differ; missing source conditions remain explicit; estimates cannot establish clinical utility or broad generalization.
This is agent primary-source rechecking and independent arithmetic validation, not an independent human peer-review signoff.
Original dual-task formal state, results and publication gates remain blocked.
